cases.input: One event is recognised as EUR 100000 in the statutory ledger and USD 44000 in management under different pinned policy revisions.
cases.expect: Each ledger posts and balances independently while sibling links record the divergence basis.

cases.input: A statutory correction is discovered after hard close.
cases.expect: An authorised linked correction posts in the earliest permitted period and leaves the original entry immutable.

cases.input: An account hierarchy is reorganised for the next fiscal year.
cases.expect: A successor chart revision preserves predecessor paths and historical posting interpretation.

cases.input: Account code 4000 is treated as globally identical across two ledgers and chart revisions.
cases.expect: The identity merge is rejected because account interpretation is ledger- and revision-scoped.

cases.input: A debit in the statutory ledger offsets a credit in management to balance one entry.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected because balancing scope never spans ledgers.

cases.input: A new recognition policy rewrites prior posted entries in place.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected; successor policy and linked correction or restatement are required.

cases.input: A current balance is stored as an attribute of the chart account definition.
cases.expect: The record is rejected because balances are external as-of assertions with derivation authority.
